meta.title: AI Inside — Platform With Frontier Brain (BTC Perp / 5m-1h)
meta.subject: Research-and-execution platform with AI inside (not LLM that trades)
meta.author: User architecture specification
meta.description: Six-layer platform oriented to BTC perpetual futures (5m-1h). Frontier model produces strategy/policy; Jev evaluates bounded state; deterministic risk kernel approves; execution delivers. NIFTY futures / options layered later. No live execution in v1.

nodes.label: Market Sources
nodes.detail: BTC venue (WS/REST); NIFTY broker (Kite/Upstox WS); macro/news

nodes.label: Market State
nodes.detail: Prices / book / vol / OI / funding / regime / liquidity score. Normalized common schema.

nodes.label: Quant Engine
nodes.detail: LightGBM/XGBoost + baseline. Outputs probs (up/down/expected return) per horizon.

nodes.label: Frontier Brain
nodes.detail: Hypothesis + strategy design + regime analysis. Produces POLICY CANDIDATE, not orders.

nodes.label: Policy Engine
nodes.detail: Strategy version, conditions, thresholds, allowed actions. Converts brain -> executable policy.

nodes.label: Jev (Fast Judgment)
nodes.detail: Bounded yes/no / choice / evaluation / ratings (TypeSafe API). Many questions per state.

nodes.label: Risk Kernel (Hard)
nodes.detail: Position / loss / exposure / liquidity / kill-switch / stale-data / spread limits. Non-AI. Cannot be overridden.

nodes.label: Execution Engine
nodes.detail: Sizing + order (market/limit/stop) + fill tracking. Deterministic. Shadow + live paths.

nodes.label: Observability
nodes.detail: PnL attribution / calibration / strategy degradation / replayable by timestamp.

annotations.label: NOTE: BTC perpetual primary (5m-1h). NIFTY futures second. NIFTY options deferred — contract surface (weekly/monthly/quarterly + Tue expiries) = direction/magnitude/timing/IV/skew/expiry/strike/Greeks/liquidity/spread complexity. See NSE contract specs.

Interface separation (core idea): Frontier -> Policy -> Jev -> Risk -> Execution. Frontier is NOT on ms/sec critical path. Produces strategy candidates; Jev evaluates bounded states at high volume; Risk hard non-AI rules; Execution deterministic.

Stack: NATS/Redpanda (bus) · Redis hot · ClickHouse ticks · Parquet archive · LightGBM/XGBoost quant · PyTorch (where justified) · VectorBT · Jev TypeSafe API · MLflow registry · Prometheus/Grafana · React · Docker Compose (no K8s initially).

Shadow trader + adversarial strategist: every live decision -> actual + hypothetical (shadow) + kill-strategy process. MLflow tracks versions (momentum_v7/v8...). Replay by replaying market-state at past timestamp.
